description: This file defines API endpoints for managing delivery operations within a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting deliveries, appending status events, ingesting location data, and exporting data as CSV. It utilizes SQLAlchemy models and Pydantic schemas to handle delivery data and associated entities.

classes.name: ListQueryParams
classes.description: Validation model for list query parameters, including filters for status, user_id, search query, limit, and offset.

classes.name: StatusUpdateRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating delivery status, including status, optional note, and optional timestamp.

classes.name: LocationIngestRequest
classes.description: Schema for ingesting location data points, including latitude, longitude, optional altitude, accuracy, timestamp, and source.

methods.name: None _assert_owner_or_admin( *, resource_user_id: int, current_user: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the owner or an admin; raises 403 if not.

methods.name: Delivery _load_delivery_or_404(db: Session, delivery_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a Delivery by ID or raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: DeliveryOut _delivery_to_out(d: Delivery)
methods.description: Converts a Delivery ORM instance to DeliveryOut schema.

methods.name: DeliveryLocationOut _location_to_out(loc: DeliveryLocation)
methods.description: Converts a DeliveryLocation ORM instance to DeliveryLocationOut schema.

methods.name: DeliveryStatusEventOut _status_to_out(ev: DeliveryStatusEvent)
methods.description: Converts a DeliveryStatusEvent ORM instance to DeliveryStatusEventOut schema.

methods.name: List[DeliveryOut] list_deliveries( status: Optional[DeliveryStatus] = Query(None, description="Filter by status"), user_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=1, description="Owner user id (admin only)"), q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in tracking_code or title"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists deliveries filtered by optional status, user_id, search query, with pagination. Restricted to user's own deliveries unless admin.

methods.name: DeliveryOut create_delivery( payload: DeliveryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new delivery record. Only allows users to create for themselves, checks for unique tracking code.

methods.name: DeliveryDetail get_delivery( delivery_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a delivery, including latest location and recent status events, verifying user permissions.

methods.name: DeliveryOut update_delivery( delivery_id: int, payload: DeliveryUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Partially updates delivery fields; logs status change events.

methods.name: Response delete_delivery( delivery_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes specified delivery if user is owner or admin.

methods.name: DeliveryStatusEventOut append_status( delivery_id: int, payload: StatusUpdateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Adds a new status event to a delivery, updating its current status.

methods.name: DeliveryLocationOut ingest_location( delivery_id: int, payload: LocationIngestRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Records a location data point for a delivery, verifying permissions.

methods.name: Response export_csv( status: Optional[DeliveryStatus] = Query(None), user_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, ge=1), q: Optional[str] = Query(None), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Exports delivery data as CSV based on filters, for admin or owner.
